reason: The README links per-model inference examples, and the Stable Diffusion v1.5 text-to-image example is small (~4-5 GB, ungated on ModelScope) and can run on CPU.
goal: Install DiffSynth-Studio from source (pip install -e .) and run the Stable Diffusion v1.5 text-to-image example, examples/stable_diffusion/model_inference/stable-diffusion-v1-5.py, on CPU only (change rand_device and device from cuda to cpu as needed; fewer inference steps such as 20 are fine). Models download automatically from ModelScope. It must produce a valid 512x512 image from the prompt 'a photo of an astronaut riding a horse on mars'.
check: The hidden test runs the SD1.5 pipeline on CPU with its own prompt and checks that a 512x512 non-blank image is written.
